# Courier app

## Requirements

- Proof of delivery photos must be deleted after 90 days under the Customer Contract.
- Drivers must not use the app while the vehicle is moving, as set out in Road Safety Code 12.

## Stories

- As a driver, I want to take a photo of the parcel at the door so that I can prove delivery.
- As a dispatcher, I want to see where each van is so that I can reassign jobs.
- As a driver, I want the app to lock its screen while the van is moving so that I stay within the safety code.
